meta.title: CMSG — Computational Materials Science Group
meta.description: The Computational Materials Science Group at Soochow University studies materials with physics-based simulation, data, and machine learning.

hero.title: Designing clearer routes through complex matter.
hero.summary: A computational materials group based at Soochow University, working across physics, data, and design.

intro.label: The group
intro.title: CMSG brings physics, data, and materials design into one working practice.
intro.body: Based in the School of Energy and the Soochow Institute of Energy and Materials Innovations, we build computational tools and collaborations that make complex materials questions easier to see, test, and share.
